text:
A student places object X on a balance. The student first brings magnet Y and then magnet Z
close to object X and observes the readings on the balance. The distance between Y and X is the
same as the distance between Z and X.
The diagram shows the results of the experiment.

Which statement explains the results?
A
Object X is an iron block and magnet Y is stronger than magnet Z.
B
Object X is an iron block and magnet Y is weaker than magnet Z.
C
Object X is a permanent magnet and magnet Y is stronger than magnet Z.
D
Object X is a permanent magnet and magnet Y is weaker than magnet Z.
